resources.string: DeepSleep uses this Accessibility Service to automate opening App Settings and tapping 'Force Stop' on your selected apps to put them into deep hibernation. No screen content or personal data is collected or stored.
Put background apps into deep hibernation
Accessibility Service is active and ready to hibernate apps.
Accessibility Service is required to automate Force Stop without root.
Please select at least one app to hibernate.
To stop background cache buildup, phantom battery drain, and unwanted wake locks, Android requires putting apps into "Force Stop" state.
DeepSleep uses the Accessibility Service solely to automate navigating to each selected app\'s system settings and clicking the "Force Stop" button on your behalf.
• We DO NOT collect, store, or transmit any personal data.\n• We DO NOT monitor keystrokes, personal messages, or screen text.\n• The service runs only when you tap "Hibernate Selected Apps".
Hibernation complete! %1$d apps put to sleep.
